HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR  S.B. Criminal Misc(Pet.) No. 1877/2  Sukhmandar Singh S/o Shri Bhupendar Singh, Aged About  Years, R/o Chak 2 Dda, Nai Mandi Gharsana, Sri Gangan  (Raj.)

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shyam Lal S/o Shri Mahavir Prasad, R/o Satt  Chattargarh, District Bikaner (Raj.)
For Petitioner(s) : Mr. D.S. Thind  For Respondent(s) : Mr. Mukesh Trivedi  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR GARG Order 20/04/2023 Heard.
Learned Public Prosecutor accepts notices on behalf of respondent No.1-State.
Issue notice to the respondent No.2.
Rule is made returnable in the month of July.

In the meanwhile and till next date of hearing, petitioner shall not be arrested in FIR No.36/2023,
Police Station Chhatargarh, District Bikaner for offences under Sections 420, 406 and 120-B of IPC.
However, he shall join the investigation.

(MANOJ KUMAR GARG),J 75-Rashi/-
